app.name: JioSaavn – Music & Podcasts
app.description: India's leading music streaming app with 80 million songs, podcasts, and exclusive content across multiple languages.

verdict.one_liner: Extensive tracking and ad targeting across devices, with long-term data retention and broad third-party sharing.
verdict.summary: JioSaavn collects detailed usage data, device identifiers, and location information to personalize content and advertisements. Data is shared with advertising networks, analytics providers, and business partners. Some cookies and device IDs are retained for up to 20 years. Users have limited opt-out options for interest-based advertising.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app tracks your listening habits across devices using advertising identifiers and shares data with numerous third parties for targeted ads. Some tracking cookies persist for up to 20 years. Consider whether the music content is worth the extensive data collection.

red.title: Comprehensive behavioral tracking for targeted ads across devices
red.plain_english: The policy states they track everything you listen to, your device info, browsing activity, and use advertising identifiers (IDFA/GAID) to show personalized ads across all your devices.

red.title: Data shared with advertising networks and analytics companies
red.plain_english: Your information is shared with advertisers, advertising networks, advertising servers, analytics companies, business partners, and rights holders.

red.title: Some tracking cookies last up to 20 years
red.plain_english: The policy's cookie table shows some cookies (device_id, latlong, ssid) are set to expire after 20 years, enabling long-term tracking.

red.title: Location collected from multiple sources and shared
red.plain_english: The policy collects approximate GPS location with consent, and also derives location from IP address and WiFi. This location data may be shared with third parties for analytics and advertising.

red.title: Unique device identifiers collected automatically
red.plain_english: The policy collects IP addresses, device IDs, AD-IDs/IDFAs, hardware model, and mobile network information to create unique device IDs for tracking.

red.title: Residual data remains after account deletion
red.plain_english: The policy states it is not always possible to completely remove all information from databases due to backups and other reasons.

green.title: Some opt-out options for interest-based advertising
green.plain_english: The policy provides links to opt out of interest-based advertising through DAA, NAI, and EDAA for users in different regions.

green.title: Account deletion available with 30-day grace period
green.plain_english: Users can delete their account through app settings, with data scheduled for deletion within 30 days. You can cancel deletion if you log in during this period.

green.title: GDPR rights provided for European users
green.plain_english: European users have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, object to marketing, and data portability.

green.title: Platform not directed to children under 18
green.plain_english: The policy states they do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18 years of age.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Does not access camera or microphone.
categories.detail: As a music streaming app, JioSaavn does not require camera or microphone access. The policy does not mention any collection of camera or microphone data.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Collects approximate GPS location with your consent, and also derives location from IP address and WiFi for targeted content and ads.
categories.detail: The policy states they collect general location from GPS with express consent (approximate, not specific), and also from IP address and WiFi. Location may be shared with third parties for analytics and advertising purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to turn on your Wi-Fi or other geolocation functionality... the App may collect and use your geolocation information. The GPS location will not be specific but will be an approximate location... We may share your location with certain third-parties for analytics and advertising purposes.
concerns: Location shared with third parties for advertising
IP-based location collected even without GPS consent

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: May access your phone contacts and social media friends if you connect via social login or refer others.
categories.detail: If you create an account using social media credentials, they have access to certain information from that site including profile and account information. Social media connections may share friend lists.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you create an account using your credentials from a third-party social media site, we will have access to certain information from that site, such as your name, profile and account information.
concerns: Social login may expose friend lists and profile data

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Accesses storage for downloads and cached content. Photos may be collected if you choose to upload them.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting photos as part of personal information. The app allows downloads for offline play which requires storage access.
categories.policy_excerpt: personal information, such as your name, e-mail address, telephone number, mobile phone number, geographic location, date of birth, demographic information, photos
concerns: Photos may be collected if uploaded

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Data is extensively shared with advertisers, advertising networks, analytics companies, business partners, service providers, and rights holders.
categories.detail: The policy states information is shared with third parties that perform functions on their behalf, sponsors, partners, advertisers, advertising networks, advertising servers, analytics companies, and rights holders. Data may also be shared in business transfers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your information may also be used by us or shared with our sponsors, partners, advertisers, advertising networks, advertising servers, and analytics companies or other third parties in connection with marketing, promotional, and other offers

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Requires name, email, phone, location, DOB, and demographic info. Social login exposes additional profile data.
categories.detail: Collects extensive identity data including name, email, phone, geographic location, date of birth, demographic information, and social media account details when connecting via social login.
categories.policy_excerpt: personal information, such as your name, e-mail address, telephone number, mobile phone number, geographic location, date of birth, demographic information, photos, and social media account details

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Tracks all listening activity, browsing behavior, and device interactions to personalize ads across the internet.
categories.detail: Collects detailed usage information including browser type, OS, activations, purchases, content accessed, listening times, page views, and interactions. Uses IDFA/AD-IDs for cross-device tracking. Shares data with advertising networks for interest-based advertising across the internet.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may allow third parties to serve you ads across the Internet and use third party ad networks providers to help present ads on the Platform using Cookies and similar technologies
concerns: Ads served across the internet based on JioSaavn activity

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Platform is not directed to children under 18 and claims not to knowingly collect data from minors.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states the platform is not directed to children under 18 and they do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If discovered, they will not use or maintain the information.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Platform is not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18 years of age.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Logs all network activity including browser type, content accessed, listening times, page views, and interactions with songs and ads.
categories.detail: Extensive logging of all platform usage including browser type, OS, activations, purchases, content accessed, download listening times, page served, preceding page views, and interactions with content and ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information is logged about your use of the Platforms, including your browser type, operating system, activations, purchases, content you access, download listening times and the page served and the preceding page views
concerns: Data used for advertising and analytics

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Collects IP address, device IDs, advertising identifiers (IDFA/AD-IDs), hardware model, and mobile network info to create unique device IDs.
categories.detail: Automatically collects IP address, device identifiers including AD-IDs/IDFAs (with consent for iOS, automatic for Android), hardware model, and mobile network information. Creates unique device IDs using cookies, tracking GIFs, web beacons, pixel codes, and in-app IDs.
categories.policy_excerpt: JioSaavn may automatically collect your IP address or other unique identifier ('Device Identifier') for the computer, mobile device, tablet or other device... including AD-IDs or IDFAs
concerns: Unique device IDs created for tracking

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health, biometric, or fitness data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment data is processed by third-party payment processors for subscriptions and purchases.
categories.detail: The policy mentions processing payments and transactions, but full payment details are handled by third-party processors. Payment-related information is collected when you subscribe or make purchases.
categories.policy_excerpt: process transactions and send you related information

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Account deletion available with 30-day grace period, but some residual data may remain in backups.
categories.detail: Users can delete their account through settings, with deletion scheduled within 30 days. A 30-day grace period allows account recovery. However, the policy states it is not always possible to completely remove all information due to backups and other reasons.
categories.policy_excerpt: you should be aware that it is not always possible to completely remove or delete all of your information from our databases without some residual data because of backups and other reasons

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Changes posted on the page and substantive changes notified by email. Continued use after updates means acceptance.
categories.detail: Changes are posted on the privacy policy page. Substantive changes are notified by email. Users are expected to check back frequently for updates. If you do not agree with updates, you should not continue using the Platform.
categories.policy_excerpt: Any changes we may make to our Privacy Policy will be posted on this page and, in relation to substantive changes, will be notified to you by email. If you do not agree or consent to these updates or changes, do not continue to use the Platform.
concerns: Users must proactively check for updates
